conditional_acceptance_requirements: Bind service or static WCET to the exact accepted P02 target runtime, P01 process set, platform configuration and valid authority material. No route is selected by this dossier.

For service-based proof, define compatible bounded whole-window work units and the exact lower service guarantee, latency, interference assumptions and covered process/window; a desired W/budget ratio or CPU label is not a service guarantee.

Distinguish rate per CPU-time from rate per wall-time. A CPU-time execution rate requires separately bounded denied service, waiting and scheduling before a wall-time conclusion. Concurrent-process CPU sum is not automatically elapsed time.

For static WCET-based proof, supply justified exact-platform execution, clock, memory/cache/native and scheduling/load assumptions; do not replace missing service by a watchdog or an empirical sample.

P06 must supply complete work, P07 must prove work/service/units/assumptions compatibility and delay attribution, and P08 must derive all ordered success-phase uppers. P03 alone neither proves program work fits nor supplies missing terms.
